contact.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
contact.faq.q1.question: How quickly can I expect a response?
contact.faq.q1.answer: We typically respond to inquiries within 24 hours during business days. Premium users receive priority support with faster response times.
contact.faq.q2.question: Do you offer phone support?
contact.faq.q2.answer: Yes, phone support is available Monday through Friday, 9AM-6PM PST. You can also schedule a callback through our support portal.
contact.faq.q3.question: Can I schedule a demo?
contact.faq.q3.answer: Absolutely! We offer personalized demos for institutions and organizations. Use the contact form or call us directly to schedule.
